facts.label: Contar o tempo e fazer planos
facts.sub: Use We have + número + minutes para o tempo que falta. Pergunte What is your resolution? Responda com I am going to + verbo. Ofereça com Do you want some…?

facts.label: Contagem regressiva
facts.sub: Ao se aproximar da meia-noite, todos contam em voz alta: ten, nine, eight… Quando chega a zero, as pessoas gritam “Happy New Year!”, se abraçam e brindam.

facts.label: Brindes
facts.sub: Os adultos brindam com espumante ou outra bebida, e as crianças com suco. Os brindes aparecem em festas de família e entre amigos, sempre com um “cheers!”.

pages.title: A countdown to the new year · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eleven forty on December thirty-first in Miami. Music comes from the living room. Eli rings the doorbell with a bag in his hand. Maya opens the door in a long shiny dress. The clock on the wall is almost at midnight. Everybody laughs, dances and waits for the new year.

“Eli, you are here! We have twenty minutes before midnight.” says Maya. “Great! I have confetti and a noisemaker. Where do I put them?” says Eli. “Put them on the table. Look, there are streamers on the wall.” says Maya.
